declared_mesh_floor.scope: Conditional analytical compute floor assuming one useful MAC per PE per cycle; stock source declaration only, not throughput measurement or bitstream derivation. Excludes issue, fill/drain, data movement and all host work.

proposal.mechanism: Prepared monotone source-polynomial inverse observation cells
proposal.idea: Construct source-plan-derived preimages of BF16 rounding cells over admitted finite F32 score domain. Runtime interval membership can certify probability bins by comparisons instead of evaluating both cubic endpoints. Retain source-word endpoint ranges and source-ordered denominator accumulation; coarse bin-only denominator bounds cannot silently replace current tighter ranges. Whole-row scale and final i8 observations remain mandatory.
required_proof: Exact chosen source F32 operations and rounding at every polynomial step, cutoff and signedzero
Complete monotonicity on admitted range, independently checked threshold neighbors and closed boundary convention
Both escaping BF16 scale and i8 closure; denominator interval widening/replay included in complete cost
proposal.status: Proposal only; feasibility and table construction cost unknown. Existing one-endpoint and deferred-probability negatives must be checked before implementation. No new numerical precision policy.
